title: HelpDesk Version 2.6.3 Update
summary: HelpDesk Version 2.6.3 is online. This update fixes the deployment announcement so the version update message can post in #server-logs while regular non-ticket logs remain filtered.
added: Added a safer deployment update path for official HelpDesk version announcements.
changed: Official version update announcements are allowed in #server-logs.
Regular non-ticket server logs remain filtered out of #server-logs.
Future deployment notes will use the HelpDesk version instead of NEWEST UPDATE wording.
Existing ticket controls, reply controls, support ban controls, funny Watching status, and Founder/Admin access remain unchanged.
removed: Removed NEWEST UPDATE wording from the deployment notes.
